paragraphs: loveholidays is building progressive technology to improve how customers discover, book and experience holidays. The Applied AI team sits within the AI Centre of Excellence, reporting to the Lead Applied AI Engineer, and works with business verticals, engineering, security, vendors and stakeholders. The role involves administering and continuously improving SaaS platforms and AI‑enabled services, managing configuration, access, environments, integrations and lifecycle. It also requires building and maintaining applied and agentic AI workflows that connect models, tools, business data, APIs and SaaS systems. Monitoring service health, usage, cost and performance, and leading testing, evaluation and incident triage are essential to ensure reliability and prevent recurring issues throughout the operation daily processes.

I have delivered integrations and REST APIs in a production environment, applying the same principles required for SaaS administration. In that setting I configured and managed API connections, ensuring secure access and reliable data flow across services. My work involved setting up integration pipelines, handling authentication, and maintaining version control to support continuous delivery. By operating within a fintech context I adhered to strict governance while scaling the integrations to meet business demand. This experience aligns directly with the need to administer cloud‑based business systems, manage user access, environments and vendor support, and to translate stakeholder requirements into effective platform configurations and ensure smooth operation across all teams involved daily.

I have performed rigorous evaluation of integrations, conducting around 65 tests across eight files to verify functionality and performance. Each test examined the interaction between APIs, data pipelines and AI services, confirming that the integrated components behaved as expected under varied conditions. The evaluation process included logging results, analysing failures and iterating on configurations to improve reliability. By systematically testing the integrations I demonstrated the ability to assess and enhance complex workflows, meeting the requirement for thorough evaluation of AI‑enabled services. This aligns with the role’s focus on monitoring service health, leading testing and incident triage, and delivering dependable automation pipelines through continuous refinement and documentation for future scalability needs.
